mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_evaluation_run (dataset_version, candidate_label, engine, status, case_count, created_by, create_time) VALUES (#{datasetVersion}, #{candidateLabel}, #{engine}, #{status}, #{caseCount}, #{createdBy}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_evaluation_run SET status = 'running', start_time = NOW(), error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'queued'

UPDATE ai_evaluation_run SET status = 'completed', passed_count = #{passedCount}, average_quality_score = #{averageQualityScore}, estimated_input_tokens = #{estimatedInputTokens}, estimated_output_tokens = #{estimatedOutputTokens}, estimated_cost = #{estimatedCost}, average_latency_ms = #{averageLatencyMs}, p95_latency_ms = #{p95LatencyMs}, finish_time = NOW(), error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_evaluation_case_result (run_id, case_id, category, prompt_key, prompt_version_id, prompt_release_id, passed, quality_score, concept_coverage, missing_concepts_json, forbidden_hits_json, response_text, response_chars, estimated_input_tokens, estimated_output_tokens, estimated_cost, end_to_end_latency_ms, failure_reason, error_message, create_time) VALUES (#{runId}, #{caseId}, #{category}, #{promptKey}, #{promptVersionId}, #{promptReleaseId}, #{passed}, #{qualityScore}, #{conceptCoverage}, #{missingConceptsJson}, #{forbiddenHitsJson}, #{responseText}, #{responseChars}, #{estimatedInputTokens}, #{estimatedOutputTokens}, #{estimatedCost}, #{endToEndLatencyMs}, #{failureReason}, #{errorMessage}, #{createTime})
